candidate.answerReason: 0.2 is one fifth, so the whole whose fifth is 18 is 18 × 5 = 90, choice B.

methods.label: Find the whole from one fifth
methods.explanation:
\(20\%\) of a number is 18. Since \(0.2=20\%=\frac15\), the whole consists of five equal parts of 18:
\[
18 \times 5 = 90.
\]
The number is 90. The answer is \(90\), choice B.
methods.levelReason: Converting 20% to one fifth and recovering five equal parts use Grade 6 percentage knowledge and elementary multiplication.
